verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a hosted email client, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack documents no opt-out control. The only on-topic material is community reports that the privacy policy permits sharing data with analytics providers, which says nothing about whether users can opt out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
